title: TerminalExitedPayload

signal.description: The signal that ended it, when one did.

cause.description: Why a terminal ended: its process exited on its own, terminals.close closed it, its session was deleted, or its shell failed to start after the open was accepted (exit code -1, the error in its scrollback).

description: terminal.exited: the terminal ended, and why. The subscription ends after it: deleted when its session was deleted, closed otherwise.
